subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw standardize an inert `name` field for opaque-ID group and room config entries across core and channel plugins?
rationale: The request adds public configuration surface across multiple owner boundaries, and only maintainers can confirm the canonical field name, scope, and whether the existing JSON5-comment and channel-resolution paths are sufficient.

options.title: Standardize inert `name`
options.body: Adopt `name?: string` for opaque-ID group and room entries, with stable identifiers remaining the sole runtime routing and authorization keys.

options.title: Keep existing lookup paths
options.body: Add no config field and rely on JSON5 comments, channel-provided subjects, and `openclaw channels resolve` for human and agent lookup.

recommendation.title: Standardize inert `name`
recommendation.body: Adopt `name?: string` for opaque-ID group and room entries, with stable identifiers remaining the sole runtime routing and authorization keys.

likelyOwner.reason: The central schema history and prior issue review make this person the strongest available owner for the cross-channel config-contract decision.
